```{r}
# install packages listed below

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
library(cowplot)
library(magick)


# =========================================
# 1. SETUP & STYLE
# =========================================
team_primary <- "#051A39"    # Banyan Navy
bg_color <- "#AC975E"        # Banyan Gold

# Pitch Colors
pitch_colors <- c(
  "Fastball" = "#D92027",  # Red
  "Two-seam Fastball" = "#ED7014", # Orange
  "Cutter" = "#FFC425",    # Yellow
  "Slider" = "#00B1B0",    # Teal
  "Curveball" = "#005792", # Blue
  "ChangeUp" = "#A020F0",  # Purple
  "Splitter" = "#AC975E",  # Gold
  "Knuckleball" = "#808080" # Grey
)

# Theme for the plots (White inside, Gold outside)
theme_report <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(color = "#051A39"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    
    # --- Backgrounds ---
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = bg_color, color = NA), # Gold outer area
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA), # White inner plot area
    # -------------------
    
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1.2),
    panel.grid = element_line(color = "#eeeeee"),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

# Theme for wrapped elements (tables, etc.) to have a gold background
theme_wrapper <- theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = bg_color, color = NA))

# =========================================
# 2. DUMMY DATA GENERATION
# =========================================
set.seed(101)
N <- 90
dummy_data <- tibble(
  PitchNo = 1:N,
  TaggedPitchType = sample(c("Fastball", "Cutter", "Curveball", "ChangeUp"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.5, 0.2, 0.2, 0.1)),
  RelSpeed = rnorm(N, 92, 3),
  SpinRate = rnorm(N, 2300, 100),
  HorzBreak = rnorm(N, 5, 8),
  InducedVertBreak = rnorm(N, 15, 5),
  RelHeight = rnorm(N, 6.2, 0.1),
  RelSide = rnorm(N, -1.2, 0.1),
  Extension = rnorm(N, 6.4, 0.1),
  PlateLocHeight = rnorm(N, 2.5, 1),
  PlateLocSide = rnorm(N, 0, 1),
  PitchCall = sample(c("StrikeCalled", "BallCalled", "InPlay", "Foul", "StrikeSwinging"), N, replace = T),
  ExitSpeed = rnorm(N, 90, 10),
  Angle = rnorm(N, 15, 20)
) %>%
  mutate(
    isStrike = PitchCall %in% c("StrikeCalled", "Foul", "StrikeSwinging", "InPlay"),
    isWhiff = PitchCall == "StrikeSwinging",
    isSwing = PitchCall %in% c("Foul", "StrikeSwinging", "InPlay"),
    isInPlay = PitchCall == "InPlay",
    Tilt = "11:00",
    PlotLocSide = pmax(pmin(PlateLocSide, 3), -3),
    PlotLocHeight = pmax(pmin(PlateLocHeight, 5), -1)
  )

# =========================================
# 3. CREATE TABLES
# =========================================
make_pretty_table <- function(data, font_size = 10, padding_mm = 4) {
  t_theme <- ttheme_default(
    core = list(bg_params = list(fill = c("white", "#EFEFEF"), col = "white"),
                fg_params = list(fontsize = font_size), 
                padding = unit(c(padding_mm, padding_mm), "mm")),
    colhead = list(bg_params = list(fill = "#051A39", col = "white"),
                   fg_params = list(fontsize = font_size, fontface = "bold", col = "white"),
                   padding = unit(c(padding_mm, padding_mm), "mm"))
  )
  tableGrob(data, rows = NULL, theme = t_theme)
}

# Top Summary Table
main_tbl_data <- dummy_data %>%
  group_by(`Pitch Type` = TaggedPitchType) %>%
  summarise(
    `#` = n(),
    `Avg Velo` = sprintf("%.1f", mean(RelSpeed)),
    `Max Velo` = sprintf("%.1f", max(RelSpeed)),
    `Avg Spin` = round(mean(SpinRate)),
    `Vert` = sprintf("%.1f", mean(InducedVertBreak)),
    `Horz` = sprintf("%.1f", mean(HorzBreak)),
    `Tilt` = first(Tilt),
    `Rel H` = sprintf("%.2f", mean(RelHeight)),
    `Rel S` = sprintf("%.2f", mean(RelSide)),
    `Ext` = sprintf("%.2f", mean(Extension)),
    `Strike%` = sprintf("%.0f%%", mean(isStrike)*100),
    `Whiff%` = sprintf("%.0f%%", sum(isWhiff)/sum(isSwing)*100)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(`#`))

# BIP Box
bip_data <- dummy_data %>%
  filter(isInPlay) %>%
  summarise(
    BIP = as.character(n()),
    `Avg EV` = sprintf("%.1f", mean(ExitSpeed)),
    `Hard%` = sprintf("%.0f%%", mean(ExitSpeed > 95)*100),
    `Gnd%` = sprintf("%.0f%%", mean(Angle < 10)*100)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Val")

# Count Box
count_data <- tibble(
  Count = c("0-0", "1-1", "Full"),
  Pitches = c(15, 8, 12),
  `Strk%` = c("60%", "50%", "100%")
)

# --- CREATING THE GROBS ---
# Top Table: Largest
grob_main <- make_pretty_table(main_tbl_data, font_size = 13, padding_mm = 8)

# Bottom Tables: Size 12, 6mm padding
grob_bip <- make_pretty_table(bip_data, font_size = 12, padding_mm = 6)
grob_count <- make_pretty_table(count_data, font_size = 12, padding_mm = 6)

# =========================================
# 4. CREATE PLOTS & IMPORT LOGO
# =========================================

# Header Plot
p_header <- ggplot() +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 1, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = team_primary) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "Banyan Pitcher", fontface = "bold", size = 12, colour = "#FEFFFD") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.02, y = 0.75, label = "PITCHER REPORT", hjust = 0, size = 5, fontface = "bold", colour = "#FEFFFD") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.98, y = 0.75, label = "Jan. 30th vs SXU", hjust = 1, size = 5, fontface = "bold",  colour = "#FEFFFD") +
  theme_void() + 
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = bg_color, color = NA))

# Release Batter View
p_release_bv <- dummy_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = RelSide, y = RelHeight, fill = TaggedPitchType)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 4, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pitch_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-3, 3)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(4, 7)) +
  labs(title = "RELEASE BATTER VIEW") + theme_report + theme(axis.text = element_blank())

# Zone Plot
p_zone <- dummy_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PlotLocSide, y = PlotLocHeight, fill = TaggedPitchType)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -0.83, xmax = 0.83, ymin = 1.5, ymax = 3.5, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 4, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pitch_colors) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = c(-2.5, 2.5), ylim = c(0, 5)) +
  labs(title = "PITCH LOCATION") + theme_report + theme(axis.text = element_blank())

# Movement Plot (Expanded Axes)
p_movement <- dummy_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = HorzBreak, y = InducedVertBreak, fill = TaggedPitchType)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 4, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pitch_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-30, 30)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-25, 25)) +
  labs(title = "MOVEMENT") + theme_report

# Side View
p_release_side <- ggplot() +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -5, xmax = 60, ymin = -1, ymax = 0, fill = "#8B4513") +
  annotate("point", x = 0, y = 6, size = 5, color = "red") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, 10)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 7)) +
  labs(title = "RELEASE SIDE VIEW") + theme_report + theme(axis.text = element_blank())

# Legend Box (Navy background)
p_legend <- dummy_data %>% distinct(TaggedPitchType) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = 1, y = TaggedPitchType, color = TaggedPitchType)) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = TaggedPitchType), x = 1.2, hjust = 0, size = 5, fontface="bold", color="white") +
  scale_color_manual(values = pitch_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.8, 3)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# --- LOGO IMPORT ---
# Use cowplot to draw the image into a ggplot object
# We apply the gold background theme so it blends in
p_logo <- ggdraw() + 
  draw_image("mbanyan.webp", scale = 0.9) + # scale adjusts padding slightly
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = bg_color, color = NA))


# =========================================
# 5. FINAL ASSEMBLY
# =========================================

# Wrap grobs and apply the gold background theme to the wrappers
w_main <- wrap_elements(grob_main) & theme_wrapper
w_bip <- wrap_elements(grob_bip) & theme_wrapper
w_count <- wrap_elements(grob_count) & theme_wrapper
w_legend <- wrap_elements(p_legend) & theme_wrapper
w_logo <- wrap_elements(p_logo) & theme_wrapper # Wrap the logo too

# --- NEW LAYOUT DESIGN ---
# We requested: [Release Side(F)] [BIP(G)] [Count(H)] [LOGO(J)] [Legend(I)]
# Total width must be 20 characters.
# Let's try: F(5) G(4) H(3) J(4) I(4) = 20
design_layout <- "
AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB
BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB
CCCCCCDDDDDDDDEEEEEE
CCCCCCDDDDDDDDEEEEEE
CCCCCCDDDDDDDDEEEEEE
FFFFFGGGGHHHJJJJIIII
FFFFFGGGGHHHJJJJIIII
"

final_plot <- p_header +
  w_main +
  p_release_bv + p_zone + p_movement +
  p_release_side + w_bip + w_count + w_legend + w_logo + # Add w_logo to list
  plot_layout(design = design_layout) +
  plot_annotation(theme = theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = bg_color, color = NA)))

# Save
ggsave("Banyans_Final_Report88.png", final_plot, width = 14, height = 10, units = "in", dpi = 300)

final_plot
```
